text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating a panel I've been looking forward to: Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

The question: what actually breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does?

Pilots are forgiving. Production isn't. I want to hear what the people carrying the pager have learned.

Joining me:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which builds evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

Expect specifics: failure modes, ownership fights, and what they'd do differently.

📍 Co-working space in Chelsea
🕡 6:30 pm, next Thursday
💸 Free

RSVP link in the comments. If you're shipping agents, or being asked to, come hang out. And if there's a question you want me to put to the panel, drop it below.
